utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Monday the thirteenth. Can you hear me all right? Teams reckons my microphone's somewhere else.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, you're coming through. Unlike the broken coffee machine in the canteen. Absolutely nothing coming through that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Probably doing us a favour, judging by Friday's coffee.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Needed something after the football last night. Sat through all that and then couldn't get to sleep.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: You could've watched it again. That would've done it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the sports desk. Fiona, what's already off the list?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah so, already swapped the filter on the CT1 yesterday. That's finished, not something to allocate again.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Good, CT1 closed.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I already swapped the filter on the HV board yesterday. That's done as well.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, you clipped out after filter. HV board, did you say?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: HV board, yeah. Yesterday. Finished.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: The other carry-over is still waiting on parts for the PRV on the boiler. Nothing we can do until they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, no change on the parts position. Still not here.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: So that stays blocked. No boiler PRV work being handed out this morning.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Understood. Blocked means blocked, not squeeze it in somehow.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Grace Liu, can you replace the seals on the Water Booster Pump? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll replace the seals on the Water Booster Pump. Understood on the priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Just the seals, we're saying? Not a whole pump replacement?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Just replace the seals on the Water Booster Pump, yes. That's the scope.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Fine. I've got that one, and it's ahead of the routine stuff.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Right, that's clear. Not putting that down as a normal-priority job.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And Grace, can you go to Northfield Substation to pick up the replacement parts for the IM2 today at 2pm? Drop everything for that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Today at 2pm, at Northfield Substation? Just making sure I've heard the time properly.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yes, today at 2pm. That pickup is also a drop-everything one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Okay, I'll go to Northfield Substation to pick up the replacement parts for the IM2 today at 2pm.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's collection only, isn't it? Not collecting and then fitting them as part of the same thing?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Collection only, yeah. I'm accepting the pickup, not an IM2 installation job.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: So two top-priority items with Grace. One's got the fixed 2pm time; the seals haven't got a separate deadline stated.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Exactly. Both urgent, and I'm not adding another time onto the seals.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While we're on equipment, I heard a slight rattle from the Air Compressor 1. Nothing to action yet, just mentioning what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Right, an observation, rather than another job?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, exactly. Nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Similar sort of note from me: noticed the IM2 was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: It did settle, then? Wasn't still climbing?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, it settled down. That's just the nights observation, not me asking for more work on it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Okay. Neither of those becomes a new action off the back of this call.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Um, separately, I'll swap the filter on the compressor one tomorrow morning. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Tomorrow morning for that filter, rather than today?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, tomorrow morning. I'll take it. It matters but it's not urgent, so no drop-everything treatment on that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Thanks, Jamie. The filter on the compressor one is yours for tomorrow morning, at that priority.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: And we're not quietly turning that into a rattle investigation as well?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, just the filter swap I've volunteered for. Separate from Marcus's observation.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Lovely. Otherwise one sentence from me turns into a strip-down.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: For the line 1 TCU, I'll run a function test on Friday. That's an 'if you've got a spare minute' one, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Function test only, yeah? Not changing settings as part of it?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll run a function test on the line 1 TCU, nothing beyond that.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Callum Reid on that one, on Friday, low priority — the spare-minute job.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: That's me, yes. On Friday.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: There's still the need to schedule downtime for the line 2 interlock with production next Tuesday. Normal priority. It hasn't got an owner.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Anyone able to take ownership of scheduling that with production?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I can't take ownership of it. I'm raising the gap, not volunteering.

utterances.speaker: David Whitfield
utterances.text: Can't take that one either, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Not me on top of the two we've just agreed.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: All right, nobody's taken it. Schedule downtime for the line 2 interlock with production next Tuesday, normal priority — still unowned.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: So it's not sitting against Fiona just because she read it out?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Correct. No owner. Don't want that getting mistaken for an acceptance.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Same principle applies to me mentioning the coffee machine, by the way.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Don't worry, nobody mistook that for you volunteering.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right. Anything we've accidentally doubled up before we finish?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: No. CT1 and HV board filters are already finished. PRV on the boiler is still blocked, not today's work.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And my rattle was just information. No extra job from me.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'm clear: Water Booster Pump seals, drop everything; and the IM2 replacement-parts pickup at Northfield Substation today at 2pm, same urgency. Both accepted.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: All clear from me as well.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers, everyone. That's us. Bye.
